apps.name: Achilló
apps.subtitle: Guided Achilles rehab, by ear
apps.localizedDescription: Daily post-op Achilles program: BFR, Chris's barefoot and boot-on routines, hourly quick ones, hinge ladder, imagery. Audio cues keep going with the screen locked; reminders come from the app.

versions.localizedDescription: Audio fixes from your diagnostics: the native player now actually switches on (it was being skipped at launch), restarts no longer pile up when you skip, faster start, and a crash when ending a session mid-start is gone. Diagnostics now log timings and whether the native audio module answers.

Audio falls back automatically if the native player fails, and shows the reason. New: Settings > Diagnostics, a log of audio and session events you can share. Fixed: after picking a quick one, the screen could stop responding to taps.

Reminder times are now any time you like (iOS time wheel): morning check, evening round, imagery. Quick-one spacing from 30 min to 3 h, last one up to 11 PM. Evening round and imagery default to 8 and 9 PM.
